claims.statement: No finite C can satisfy sum_v w_v Omega_v <= C I(d) for every adaptive pathwise-coordinate-nonreusing restriction hierarchy of one source, even when every local source is a union of three parallel affine cosets.

A local inequality charging the associator only to the newly queried coordinate block cannot hold with finite constant: free queried coordinates have zero directional influence while the cylinder associator is positive.
The one-node bound Omega <= 8 ln(2) I(d) for three parallel affine cosets remains valid; this run refutes only its unrestricted repeated hierarchy charging.
